What we can help with

How it works

How booking a visit works

01

Call or WhatsApp us

Ring +971 50 262 2908 or +971 50 715 6512, or send a message. A photo or a short video of the problem helps — it means we bring the right parts the first time.

02

We come and look

A technician visits, checks the problem properly, and tells you what it needs and what it will cost. Nothing starts before you've heard that.

03

You say yes, we get on with it

Once you've approved the work, we do it. We test the repair while you're there, so you can see it working, and we tidy up before we leave.

04

Afterwards

If something doesn't feel right once we've gone, message us — please don't just live with it. We can also remind you when the AC is due its next service.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Which areas of Dubai do you cover?

Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Jebel Ali, Al Satwa, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Jumeirah 1, Jumeirah 2, Arabian Ranches, The Meadows, The Springs, Emirates Hills and JLT (Jumeirah Lake Towers). Somewhere nearby that isn't on the list? Ring us and ask — we'll tell you honestly whether we can get to you.

What services does Al Hamra offer?

The short answer is: most of what a home needs. AC service & repair, electrical work, plumbing, tile fixing, painting, carpentry, gypsum work, door & lock repair, and general maintenance for apartments, villas and offices. The full list is in the Services section above.

How do I book a visit?

Whichever way suits you. Call +971 50 262 2908 or +971 50 715 6512, send us a WhatsApp message, email alhmratechnicalservices.info@gmail.com, or use the form on this page — it opens WhatsApp or your email app with your request already written, ready to send.

Do you give a price before starting work?

Yes. Nobody likes a surprise bill, so the technician looks at the job first, explains what needs doing and what it will cost, and work only starts once you've agreed. The final price depends on the job itself, the materials needed and how easy it is to reach — which is exactly why we don't quote one flat price for everything over the phone.

My AC stopped cooling — what should I check first?

Three quick things: the thermostat is set to cool, the filter isn't clogged with dust, and nothing is blocking the outdoor unit. If it's still blowing warm air, or water is dripping from it, that's a service visit — our guide “Why your AC isn't cooling” runs through the causes we see most often in Dubai homes.

Can you handle several jobs in one visit?

Usually, yes — that's rather the point of us. When you book, list everything: the AC service, the tap that drips, the bedroom door that sticks. We'll plan the visit so the right people and the right parts arrive together, instead of you booking three separate call-outs.
